title: Find Middle of Linked List - Solution
intuition: Given the head of a singly linked list, return the middle node of the linked list. If there are two middle nodes, return the second middle node.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
code:
def solution(head):
    slow = head
    fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    return slow
common_mistakes: Fast pointer moves twice as fast as slow pointer.
